contract_reuse: The first six entries reference exact accepted reader definitions to avoid maintaining duplicate contracts. They are separate Conceptual-local registrations against this run's eleven variables, not a global prompt-variable catalog. Resolve referenced schemas using the definitions in their source document. The new readers' output schemas use this document's definitions.

tools.name: get_source_context
tools.description: Return the same source_context value as the Conceptual prompt variable: contributing Source Connections and their business/type context for this frozen run. Results use the shared page envelope; follow next_cursor until complete.
tools.reuse_rule: Reuse the exact input/output schemas, default selections, natural-key rules, paging, and error behavior from this accepted reader contract. Instantiate it for the current Conceptual run and corresponding Conceptual-local variable; do not run Analysis or read a different run.

tools.name: get_gds_context
tools.description: Return the same gds_context value as the Conceptual prompt variable: actual GDS placements for scoped Objects. Results use the shared page envelope; follow next_cursor until complete.
tools.reuse_rule: Reuse the exact input/output schemas, default selections, natural-key rules, paging, and error behavior from this accepted reader contract. Instantiate it for the current Conceptual run and corresponding Conceptual-local variable; do not run Analysis or read a different run.

tools.name: get_objects
tools.description: Return scoped physical Objects associated with a complete Source Connection natural key. Bronze matches follow registered ingestion mappings and retain GDS natural keys; Source matches retain Source keys. Omit the filter to return all scoped Objects. Results use the shared page envelope; follow next_cursor until complete.
tools.reuse_rule: Reuse the exact input/output schemas, default selections, natural-key rules, paging, and error behavior from this accepted reader contract. Instantiate it for the current Conceptual run and corresponding Conceptual-local variable; do not run Analysis or read a different run.

tools.name: get_object_details
tools.description: Return Attribute metadata and saved Profiles grouped under requested in-scope physical Object keys, using the object_attribute_context structure. Omitted/empty object_keys returns all scoped groups. Results use the shared page envelope; follow next_cursor until complete.
tools.reuse_rule: Reuse the exact input/output schemas, default selections, natural-key rules, paging, and error behavior from this accepted reader contract. Instantiate it for the current Conceptual run and corresponding Conceptual-local variable; do not run Analysis or read a different run.

tools.name: get_object_relationships
tools.description: Return existing incoming and outgoing relationships grouped under requested physical Object keys, in the same shape as object_relationship_context. Omitted/empty keys returns groups for all scoped Objects. Results use the shared page envelope; follow next_cursor until complete.

tools.name: list_conceptual_objects
tools.description: List compact existing Conceptual objects: natural-key fields only, matching conceptual_object_list. Optionally filter by supporting physical object_keys; omitted/empty returns all. Use the corresponding get reader for full records.

object_keys.description: Optional complete in-scope physical Object keys copied from object_context/get_objects. Match this record's own Object supports. Omitted/empty selects all existing Conceptual identities, including Assertion-only records.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this same reader/run. Omitted/null starts a request. Continue with only cursor; the frozen selection is restored.

semantics: Read the frozen authorized Conceptual run context only. No live discovery, SQL, measurements, writes, or scope changes.

Normalize identity comparisons with existing Model key rules and preserve saved spelling. Repeated selection keys return each record identity once. Unknown or unauthorized keys are errors, never an all-record fallback.
An unavailable applied Conceptual section uses the tool-error path; it is not a successful empty list. A known empty selection returns a complete empty page.

Use the accepted page envelope and existing response/cumulative/execution budgets. Each nonfinal successful page makes progress. Continue with only cursor. Repeating a cursor yields the same page; do not append it twice.

incomplete_object_key is always null for these four readers. Directory identities and full Conceptual records are emitted whole. Never silently truncate fields or supports. A single indivisible entry exceeding the response budget produces an explicit size error.

Filter each record by its own support_source_type=object references, matching any requested complete physical Object key. Keep each natural identity once, including when several requested Objects support it.
Use actual physical placement: Source keys for Source Objects, GDS keys for Bronze. Do not translate this filter through ingestion mappings or accept bare Object names.

No source filter means all known eligible identities, including Assertion-only and inactive/deprecated history. Filtered results may include historical support matches; details determine effective status and actual coverage.

A compact entry contains identity only. It does not certify meaning, completeness, confidence, active status, or lock state. A known physical Object with no direct matching supports yields an empty directory.

Calling an enabled reader with no selection arguments requests all eligible records of that reader in the frozen authorized run, not unrestricted database records. Cursor continuation resumes its original selection.
